description: Any parent-child hierarchy as a tree of cards. Give it an ID and the ID of its parent, and it draws the rest. Who it's for HR and people-analytics teams. Finance teams with a chart of accounts or legal entities. Anyone with a parent-child table: bills of materials, product hierarchies, folder trees. The problem it solves A large org drawn whole is cropped or shrunk to text nobody can read. Real data breaks other visuals: blank roots, missing parents, reporting cycles, many reports under one manager. Collapsed branches are forgotten on refresh. What you get Readable at any size: opens folded so names stay at least 9px, with the headcount on each folded card. Navigation: a switch per level, two fit modes, a magnifying lens, a minimap and search that jumps to a person. Cards: photos, name, title and a measure, colour by group or level, span of control, vacancies. Analysis: dotted-line reporting, and joiners, leavers and movers across two periods. Three views: chart, sortable table with CSV export, and a plain-English summary. Robust: any root shape works, cycles become roots, and collapse survives refresh, filters and bookmarks. Also: cross-filtering, tooltips, right-click menu, keyboard navigation, themes, high contrast, image export. Free Every feature is free, for everyone, with no node cap. Runs entirely inside Power BI. No network calls, no external data, no telemetry.
